item.title: Year 3 at work and tech
item.description:
Year 3 at work and tech

Work and tech stuff since last blog post has continued to be around multiple different projects with multiple project titles. It’s now 3 years since I started working at a company, so it was time to collect and write down everything I’ve been working on in the past year to see where I’m at. This blog is kind of a draft, still.

I’ve become an ardent enthusiast of the enterprise. I’ve started recognizing how broad and deep things run, my compounding knowledge of the domain, the lasting effects of the work I do, the processes and relationships that already exist that makes work easier, the safety net. So many people working together aligned to a common goal and the scale of it all, is marveling.

— aswin c (@chandanaveli) March 12, 2025

My work life has revolved around multiple different projects with multiple project titles, as I wanted it to be. So, this blog post will have a logbook-like format and is like a progress report. I just wanted to write this down before I forget all of this.

item.title: Notes from my first workplace as an employee
item.description:
Hey, we’re back.

The cadence of these notes will vary like a meandering river as it was not easy to connect different things and also keep the same voice – “I am not an expert; I’m just writing it down as I fare forward and figure it out” throughout the blog. I also feel this blog post lacks a certain standard of emotional density that I thought this would have when I envisioned writing it. Nevertheless, the deliverables of an average blog post on this site: candid accounts of experiences and reflections, with an edge for optimism, can be easily observed even by the accidental audience on this blog post.
